For other uses, see [[Dragon (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Species |image= {{Media |Model OoT= File:OoT Volvagia Model.png |Model OoT3D= File:OoT3D Volvagia Model.png |Model TWW= File:TWW Valoo Model.png |Model TWWHD= File:TWWHD Valoo Model.png |Model TP= File:TP Argorok Model.png |Model TPHD= File:TPHD Argorok Model.png |Model SS= File:SS Faron Model.png |Model SSHD= File:SSHD Lanayru Model.png |Model ALBW= File:ALBW Gemesaur King Model.png |Model BotW= File:BotW Dinraal Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Light Dragon Model.png |Model EoW= File:EoW Volvagia Model.png |Sprite TLoZ= File:TLoZ Gleeok Sprite.png |Sprite TAoL= File:TAoL Barba Sprite.png |Sprite OoS= File:OoS Aquamentus Sprite.png |Sprite OoA= File:OoA Swoop Sprite.png |Sprite TMC= File:TMC Gleerok Sprite.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= TLoZ, TAoL, OoT, OoS, OoA, TWW, TMC, TP, SS, ALBW, BotW, TotK, EoW |other= AoI |era= |habitat= |attack= |weapon= |cost= |value= |characteristics= |members= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Dragon|Dragons|Series, TAoL, TWW, TWWHD, BotW, TotK, AoI|plural}} are a recurring species in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|ALttP, OoT, TWW, BotW, TotK}}{{Name Ref|OoT3D, OoS, TWW, TMC, TPHD, SSHD, ALBW}} Dragons go unnamed in {{OoA|-}}. ==Characteristics== ==={{TLoZ|-}}=== {{Main|Aquamentus, Gleeok}} [[Aquamentus]] is a one-horned Dragon and the first Dragon encountered in the {{TLoZ Series}}, serving as the [[Boss]] of [[Level 1]] and [[Level 7]], as well as being a [[Sub-Boss]] during the [[Second Quest]]. A multi-headed Dragon, [[Gleeok]], is a Boss fought in [[Level 4]] with two heads, [[Level 6]] with three heads as a Sub-Boss, and with four heads in [[Level 8]]. ==={{TAoL|-}}=== {{Main|Barba}} [[Barba]], also known as Volvagia, is the Boss of [[Three-Eye Rock Palace]], and acts as a guardian of the [[Statue]] within it. ==={{OoT|-}}=== {{Main|Volvagia}} [[Volvagia]] is the boss of the [[Fire Temple]]. It is a serpentine [[Fire]] Dragon that dives in and out of the [[Lava]] in its arena. ==={{OoS|-}}=== {{Main|Aquamentus, Onox}} [[Aquamentus]] returns as a boss enemy in {{OoS|-}}. During his final battle with Link, [[Onox]] reveals his true form to be a Dark Dragon. ==={{OoA|-}}=== {{Main|Swoop}} [[Swoop]] is a red, winged Dragon found in the [[Wing Dungeon]] as a [[Sub-Boss]]. It is named for its preferred tactic of swooping down at trespassers to attack them. ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Main|Valoo}} [[Valoo]] is a supporting character who appears on the top of [[Dragon Roost Island]]. In the game's events, he is unable to grant the [[Rito]] their ability to grow wings due to being hurt by [[Gohma]] and Link must defeat the giant scorpion. Later in the game, Valoo aids Link and Tetra in escaping [[Ganondorf]]. ==={{TMC|-}}=== {{Main|Gleerok}} [[Gleerok]] is a lava Dragon that serves as the [[Boss]] of the second [[Dungeon]]. ==={{TP|-}}=== {{Main|Argorok}} [[Argorok]] is the boss in the [[City in the Sky]]. Argorok appears as a red-orange wyvern covered in black armor. ==={{SS|-}}=== [[Eldin (Dragon)|Eldin]], [[Faron (Dragon)|Faron]], and [[Lanayru (Dragon)|Lanayru]] are protectors of the [[Surface]] and each teach [[Link]] part of the [[Song of the Hero]]. ==={{ALBW|-}}=== {{Main|Gemesaur King}} The [[Gemesaur King]] is a quadrupedal Dragon that serves as the [[Boss]] of the [[Dark Palace]]. It resembles the [[Helmasaur King]] from {{ALttP}}. The Gemesaur King is covered in colorful gems and scales, and can see well in the [[Darkness]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== The three Dragons in {{BotW|-}} are invincible and appear in various places throughout [[Hyrule]]. While not intending to harm [[Link]], their bodies shed orbs of their element which can harm him. They can be harvested for their [[Horn]]s, [[Scale]]s, [[Claw]]s, and [[Fang Shard]]s for [[Enhancing]] [[Armor]]. [[Dinraal]] has the power of [[Fire]] and frequents [[Tanagar Canyon]] and northern [[Eldin (Region)|Eldin]]. [[Farosh]] has the power of [[Electricity]] and frequents [[Gerudo Highlands]] and [[Lake Floria]]. [[Naydra]] has the power of [[Ice]] and frequents [[Mount Lanayru]] and [[Lanayru Road]]. Naydra initially appears at the summit of Mount Lanayru infected as [[Malice Naydra]] and must be freed from the [[Malice]] before she can appear regularly. The [[Zonai]] are thought to have worshiped a water Dragon. Many Dragon [[Statue]]s decorate [[Zonai Ruin]]s, which were used by them to represent the [[Triforce of Courage]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== In addition to [[Dinraal]], [[Farosh]], and [[Naydra]], two additional immortal Dragons known as the [[Light Dragon]] and [[Demon Dragon]] can be found. The Light Dragon flies high in the [[Sky|Skies]] above [[Hyrule]] and the [[Demon Dragon]] serves as the final [[Boss]]. [[Flame Gleeok|Flame]], [[Frost Gleeok|Frost]], and [[Thunder Gleeok]]s also appear as [[Sub-Boss]]es. A more powerful type of [[Gleeok]] known as [[King Gleeok]]s have a combination of each elemental head. A mortal being can become an immortal Dragon by swallowing a [[Secret Stone]]. However, this destroys the being's sense of self, and this process is thought to be irreversible. ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Main|Volvagia}} [[Volvagia]] appears as a [[Boss]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Stub|AoI}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dancing Dragon Dungeon * Dragon Fry * Dragon Key * Dragon Pillar * Dragon Roost Island * Dragon Sculpture * Dragon's Blood * Dragon's Exile * Dragon's Path * Dragon's Tear * Tall Dragon Pillar * The Dragon's Path }} {{Ref| {{Cite Book|quote=In some places, Barba is called Volvagia|book= E |page=146}} {{Cite Guide|ALttP Nintendo|page= 10 {{Exp Game|TAoL}}}} {{Cite|'''Subterranean Lava Dragon
